finalText:
**Big but not uniform.** 1291 hits in 94 files.

| Zone | Hits | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| `services` | 1200 | Safe, mostly |
| `migrations` | 61 | Do not edit, already applied |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | 20 | Do not edit, regenerated |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 5 | Frozen public contract |
| `lib` | 5 | Wire side frozen |

Four zones must not change. In [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) only the left key may move. The right one is public.

About 325 SQL strings in `services` name the real column. Those need a column-rename migration first, or reads break.
